description.value:
Duration constant

Your Bargain can no longer be broken, altered, or stolen.

Your Bargain can't be forcibly broken, altered, or stolen by any effect; attempts to do so automatically fail without a check.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Your Bargain can't be forcibly broken/altered/stolen; such attempts auto-fail without a check" protects a homebrew narrative concept (the class's own Bargain choice) with no corresponding real pf2e trait or mechanism -- there is no bargain trait or auto-fail-on-a-specific-target-effect rule element in pf2e-source.
